\label{lesson:UR-C95-khizan}

\section[tārīkh]{\ur{تاریخ} (tārīkh) — a date; history}

\label{lesson:UR-C95-tarikh}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for winter, then the Urdu for autumn.

A date needs an ordinal: say \textbf{\ur{پہلا}}, \textbf{\ur{دوسرا}}, \textbf{\ur{تیسرا}}, the first, the second and the third.
\end{quote}
